name: FIRE FIGHT 2
summary:
FIRE FIGHT 2 is a fast, physical VR platform fighter. Hold a trigger to spin up a fireball, swing and let go to throw, pull the trigger to call it home. A spinning fireball is also a shield: block, punch incoming fire to block and dodge to not get hit.

CAREER: climb from amateur to world champion against seven titans, each with its own attacks and tells. Win championship belts, run SPEEDRUN and HARDCORE and face GOOPLIATH, a giant made of liquid chrome.

VERSUS: quick match, ranked, 2v2 and free-for-all, p
